_comment: Recorded exclusions for scripts/ci/extension-registry-reconcile.mjs (cinatra#1120). Public cinatra-ai repos that are intentionally NOT part of the installable-extension dev-install registry (cinatra.devExtensions). Listing them keeps the reconciliation COMPLETE without being noisy: if any of these later gains a root package.json `cinatra.kind` block it still stays out of the MISSING report. Add an entry (repo + reason) when a new public repo is intentionally unbundled; do NOT use this to hide a genuinely-unregistered extension.

exclusions.reason: Org meta / community-health repo — not an extension.
Shared reusable CI composite actions/workflows — not an extension.
The host application repo itself (owns cinatra.devExtensions); has cinatra.* config but no cinatra.kind.
The end-user CLI package — not a host-installed extension.
Public Claude plugin (contributor tooling) — not a host-installed extension.
First-party Drupal glue module (installed into Drupal, not into the host) — never a marketplace/dev-install extension.
First-party WordPress glue plugin (installed into WordPress, not into the host) — never a marketplace/dev-install extension.
A2A dev peer-agent fixtures (opt-in a2a-peers compose profile) — test peers, not installable extensions.
